subject: Siamarkets x Redwood: Joint Solution Workshop — technical deep-dive & handoff
messages:
From: Alex Lim <alex.lim@siamarkets.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Evan Chu <evan.chu@siamarkets.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 02:12:00 +0000
Subject: Joint solution workshop — proposed 3/24 or 3/25

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the execs at Siamarkets want to move to a technical deep-dive and handoff session with our infra and SRE teams. Goal is to walk architecture, deployment options (dedicated vs private), networking, and a simple migration plan for our pilot workload.

Proposed slots (APAC-friendly):
- Wed 24 Mar, 09:00–11:00 SGT (UTC+8)
- Thu 25 Mar, 15:00–17:00 SGT (UTC+8)

Attendees from our side: me, Evan (platform lead), Priya from CloudMart (marketplace integration). Can you confirm who from Redwood should join? We expect ~10 people total (5 from Siamarkets + 3 from CloudMart + 2 architects).

We can share a pre-read (network diagram + current traffic profile) before the session. Let me know if either slot works.

Cheers,
Alex
Lead Platform Engineer | Siamarkets

Attachment: siam_current_traffic_summary.xlsx (referenced)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Lim <alex.lim@siamarkets.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 06:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Joint solution workshop — proposed 3/24 or 3/25

Alex — great to hear the execs are ready to dive in. Both slots are potentially workable, but Markus (solutions architect) and Rishi (SRE lead) flagged a conflict with the morning of 3/24. Can we target Thu 25 Mar, 15:00–17:00 SGT instead? That gives us time to prepare an architecture review and two short runbooks for networking and secrets management.

Proposed Redwood attendee list:
- Vanessa Ortiz (Partner Sales / workshop host)
- Markus Klein (Solutions Architect)
- Rishi Malhotra (SRE/Deployment lead)
- Camila Reyes (Customer Engineer / Marketplace PM)

Action items for Siamarkets before the session:
- Send the network diagram + current peak qps and egress estimates (thanks in advance).
- Privileged access note: please confirm if the pilot will require VPC peering or a transit gateway.

I attached a draft agenda and a preliminary network topology we pulled from the discovery notes.

Thanks — I’ll send a calendar invite once we lock the time.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachments: SIAM-Redwood-workshop-agenda-v1.pdf, network-topology-draft.png

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 10:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Joint solution workshop — proposed 3/24 or 3/25

Quick note — Thu 25th 15:00 SGT works for me. For the agenda, please reserve 30–40 minutes for the architecture review (model routing, quantization options, and fallback policies) and 20–30 minutes for a live Q&A where we can do a short run-through of the deployment manifest and networking checklist. I will prepare a short appendix on cost/perf tradeoffs for dedicated vs private.

Also: we should confirm whether CloudMart needs a short API handoff section (30 minutes) to discuss marketplace packaging and licensing. Camila, can you confirm?

-Markus

From: Alex Lim <alex.lim@siamarkets.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Evan Chu <evan.chu@siamarkets.com>, Priya Rao <pra@cloudmart.io>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 00:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Joint solution workshop — proposed 3/24 or 3/25

Thanks Vanessa and Markus — Thu 25th is good for us but quick update: our CFO needs to be on another call from 15:30–16:15 SGT that day. Is it possible to shift the session by 30 minutes later (15:30–17:30) or split the schedule so the first 45 minutes are the architecture review and we hold the deep Q&A 16:15–17:00 after their call? Sorry for the late ask — internal calendar conflict just came up.

Alex

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Lim <alex.lim@siamarkets.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, camila.reyes@redwood.com, Priya Rao <pra@cloudmart.io>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 01:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Joint solution workshop — final schedule and materials

Alex — no problem, we can accommodate. Final schedule below (calendar invite will follow):

Thu 25 Mar 2026 — 15:30–17:30 SGT (UTC+8) — Joint Solution Workshop
Agenda (high level):
- 15:30–16:10 Architecture review (Markus)
- 16:10–16:25 Marketplace & packaging steps (Camila + Priya)
- 16:25–16:40 Deployment/networking checklist (Rishi)
- 16:40–17:20 Live Q&A and runbook walk-through
- 17:20–17:30 Next steps & action owners (Vanessa)

I attached the updated agenda and a link to a collaborative Miro board for notes and parking-lot items. Please upload the network diagram and traffic profile to the board before EOD Wed so Markus and Rishi can review.

Practical notes:
- We will record the session and share a short recording + notes.
- If Siamarkets prefers VPC peering, Rishi will bring our checklist; for transit gateway we’ll cover routing and cost implications.
- CloudMart: Camila, please confirm whether you need any specific packaging artifacts in advance (e.g., marketplace listing manifest, contract stub).

Thanks — see you on Thu.

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachments: SIAM-Redwood-workshop-agenda-v1.pdf
Links: https://miro.com/app/board/o9J_k3SiamBoard/ (edit access granted)
